items.title: Flower Island
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Welcome to Flower Island, an amazing place with a pleasant smell of flowers. The wonderful touch of nature will captivate you. Start your survival adventure and explore what's hidden here.

- Includes 3 skins for FREE
- Huge base house to live here
- Many houses to explore
- Licensed by BreadBuilds and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Rainbow Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Test your luck with the Rainbow Lucky Blocks! Destroy the Blocks and get ready for 300 different outcomes!

+Craftable Lucky Blocks!
+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Luxury Anime
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Live life to the fullest sporting some of the trendiest outfits out there that would fit in any popular manga! This skin pack of luxurious teens is inspired by popular anime styles, perfect for a night out or a fun shopping spree.

- Includes 8 vibrant and hip skins
- Options for any gender, with unique clothing and accessories
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Abominimals
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Dressing up as an animal is fun! But have you tried being TWO at ONCE? Now you can! Check out these abominable animals.

+ Includes 8 abominations!

items.title: Sky Castles
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: On a massive skyblock world, each island has its own unique castle. A different style, biome and loot. Discover all the castles and explore it’s secrets.

items.title: Count Down
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description: Enjoy over 10 black and white styled characters in this all new skin pack Count Down.

items.title: Yacht Mansion
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Time to party!
Jump aboard your new yacht and live like a king in your new millionaire mansion!

+ Perfect for roleplay or survival
+ Single player or multiplayer
+ Giant yacht boats
+ Huge mansion house

items.title: Crazy Penguins
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Everyone loves penguins, so why not become one? Dress up in one of 7 random outfits, or just dress up as a standard penguin!

+ 10 crazy penguin skins
+ Unique outfits

items.title: Mob Reapers!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The old and spooky Mob Reapers have been haunting Minecraft!
Pay your friends a scary visit and collect their souls!

+ 12 Mob Reapers skins!
+ 1 free skin!
+ Includes creeper, zombie, and axolotl reapers!

items.title: City Friends
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you live in a big city and need a new skin with your friends? Then this skin pack is for you! Now choose your favorite skin and become one of the coolest players in the city!

+ 14 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Vintage Fashion
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
The sweet and retro vibe of the past is now back! You can bring the fashion of the past to the present with this skin pack. Choose your favorite one and show off your elegance to other players!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Lava Escape
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Minecraft but every 30 seconds lava rises! Go through all the skyblocks to collect as much loot as you can and defeat the Ender Dragon! Trade with the villagers to get better items and more blocks! But watch out! If you fall in the lava, you're out! Can you beat this extreme challenge?

+Lava escape!
+Great for multiplayer and singleplayer!

Made by the original creators!

items.title: Panda Style
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Pandas have never looked so cool. Pick up your sunglasses, put on that awesome outfit, and become the coolest panda in the world. With the Panda Style skin pack, you'll fit right in wherever you go.

- 10 skin included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Cartoon Mobs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to step into the world you grew up watching and become a cartoon. With the Cartoon Mobs skin pack, combine your favorite show with your favorite mob, and suddenly the world will look more colorful!

- 10 skins
- Own show not included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Urban Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Have fun and explore exciting adventures around the world with these new styles and aspects. 
What are you waiting for? You will love them!

- 10 different looks
- Perfect for role play
- By Pixelusion & ArkitexStudios

items.title: Vampire Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Hey! Do you know our vampire friends? No?! So what are you waiting for, come check out this skinpack where you can become an immortal being! With a variety of 8 skins I doubt you won't find one that suits your style!

- Vampire skins!
- By Pixelusion & EcoStudios

items.title: Demon Fashion
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Demon fashion is never out of style! Pick your outfit today and have the spotlight on you! 

- 21 epic skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Samurai's Temple
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
A samurai built this temple a long time ago. Located between steep mountain slopes and under the blossoming cherry trees, this temple is waiting to be explored. Grab your katana and explore this heroic temple!

- Heroic temple
- Five explorable buildings
- By Geniely

items.title: Advanced Desert Temple
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Bored of the usual desert temples and looking for a new challenge? With this advanced desert temple, a new and exciting adventure awaits you!

- Dangerous custom mobs
- Many hidden traps - Watch where you step!
- Can you find all the treasure chests?
- 3 skins included
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Wonder Valley
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description: Over every mountain, there is a path, although it may not be seen from the valley. Only if you have been in the deepest valley, can you ever know how magnificent it is to be on the highest mountain and when walking through the valley remember, a shadow is cast by the light of the Wonder Valley.

items.title: Shounen Slam
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Anime characters.... Everywhere! If you can't decide which anime pack is your best choice, take a look at this! With 12 different looking anime skins this pack should be your first choice. Pick your favorite skin and have fun together with your friends while role-playing an anime series! 

- 12 skins
- By Geniely

items.title: Rare Fashion Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Exclusive and elusive, these looks are hard to come by! Give your style a uniqueness and individuality boost with these one of a kind clothes! Gain an edge in the fashion game!

- 12 Extraordinary skins
-By RareLoot

items.title: Nether Street Fashion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Get yourself some cool new flaming hot fashion! The hottest new styles for sizzling fashion adventures in Minecraft’s most scorching hot biome!

- 12 Nether skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Slime Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Always find yourself in sticky situations? Imagine what it's like for these slime teens!

*1 Free Skin
